method: five balanced pairs on same isolated loopback OpenSSH server; Ed25519 key and strict pinned host key in separate tmp known_hosts; PTY, aes128-ctr/hmac-sha2-256, no compression; ready then 0.5s idle then 16MiB zero payload; warm OS cache, launch/auth/remote-shell to first READY measured; libproc samples at 5ms client process tree plus server tree separately; C libssh2 prototype vs ssh CLI, not full congminal integration or ssh2 Rust wrapper; no simultaneous performance jobs
notes: C prototype dynamically links installed libssh2/OpenSSL/zlib; no Cargo dependency added; not a Rust ssh2 wrapper measurement.
libproc sampled live process CPU fields as native units; idle CPU deltas were zero at sampled native resolution; no 0.2 percentage-point or long-idle acceptance claim.
Server side snapshots are separate, not part of deployed client cost. Full congminal plus child integration and budget/cleanup tests still required.
Warm cache executable launch and authentication timing, not cold OS startup. Generated client/host keys and isolated loopback only. Fixture server terminated after all runs.

cpu_timebase.note: PROC_PIDTASKINFO CPU counters are Mach absolute ticks, not ns; original field was mislabeled. Preserve raw as cpu_mach_ticks and convert cpu_ns below. All measured idle deltas were zero, so existing idle percent remains zero.
